description: This file defines an Android Activity named NotificationDisplay, which presents a notification with an interactive button. When clicked, it cancels a specific notification and launches another activity called StatusBarNotifications.

classes.name: NotificationDisplay
classes.description: An activity that displays a notification with a button; clicking the button removes the notification and launches the StatusBarNotifications activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity layout, sets window flags for blur behind, creates a relative layout with an ImageButton, and sets it as the content view.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles button clicks by canceling a specific notification, launching the StatusBarNotifications activity with a new task flag, and finishing the current activity.
